causal_boundary: Static instruction differences do not establish the cause or magnitude of the regressions. No unobserved result is assigned to noise.
proposal: Create a separate candidate with a direct small-product branch and an isolated large-product path, eliminating the duplicate arithmetic-dispatch trampoline. Examine inlining and branch placement for the square entry while preserving its small-kernel frame and all mathematical contracts.
proof_obligations: Both dispatch branches refine the same input-defined modular product or square.
Retain complete length, top-bit, alias, overflow and capacity domains; no narrower shortcut specification.
Preserve product 12n and square 10n caller-scratch requirements and actual disjoint slice bounds.
Keep the same recursive mathematical kernels and termination arguments. No new proof escape or unchecked intrinsic.
Treat wrapper restructuring as constant overhead only. It does not improve the analytic recurrence exponent.
codegen_acceptance_before_timing: The small-product call path has one dispatch length decision and no added save/restore tail-jump trampoline.
The small-square path does not acquire the large-path stack frame or extra allocation.
Compare complete reachable kernels and successful entry paths against both the baseline and this frozen candidate; retain any differences.
Inspect actual optimized code, not only source attributes; no claim of a complete formal machine-stack theorem.
experimental_requirements: A new immutable verification snapshot, independent oracle, semantic mutations, codegen gate and two predeclared complete 52-shape runs with seven repetitions and actual batches >=10ms.
